Windows overlooking the street Large enclosed modern kitchen with fridge, microwave, stove, dishwasher, coffee maker, kettle, toaster and everything necessary for cooking and eating. Several storage. Big table. Window on the street. Master bedroom with a 160cm x 200cm bed, bedside table, chest of drawers and large dressing. TV. Window onto the courtyard. Bathroom, ensuite to master bedroom with bath, sink and hair dryer. WC. Bedroom # 2 with 2 single bed, dressing. Window on the courtyard A second bathroom with walk-in shower, sink and toilet Bedroom # 3 with a bed of 140 x 200cm, bedside table. Large dressing. Window on street En-suite shower room No. 3 with walk-in shower, bathtub, double sink and hair dryer. WC. A laundry room with washer, dryer and storage.The apartment is rented with linen, iron and ironing board. Electric heater. Safe. The check in are made without extra cost from Monday to Saturday between 2 p. m. and 8 p. m. Between 8 p. m. and 10 p. m., there is an extra 35 €
